sources.snippet: The repo for the first in the Biggerbrain 3 lineup, a 151m parameter model. This model uses a Recurrent transformer (looping the central 5 layers), and soft averaged MoE architecture to achieve new levels of reasoning (reletive to the Biggerbrain lineup).
